orgDesign.companyProfile: Typical mid-size real estate marketplace with separate growth teams for seekers, owners, professionals, monetization, and shared platform capabilities. The organization is now modeled as a network of smaller teams sized around 10 FTE.
orgDesign.operatingModel: Customer-facing teams own major marketplace journeys, with data and platform teams providing reusable search, identity, and monetization foundations. Larger value streams are split into sibling teams so accountability stays close to concrete capability ownership.
designPrinciples: Demand and supply journeys are separated because they optimize for different conversion loops.
Professional tooling is its own business line rather than an extension of the consumer experience.
Marketplace monetization depends on a dedicated pricing and intelligence capability.
orgDesign.staffingPrinciple: Model total staffing around 250 FTE across delivery teams and group leadership; keep every delivery team at 6-10 FTE, with no individual team above 10 people.
orgDesign.groupingPrinciple: Use top-level groups for major value streams and a second layer of subgroups for team families when a stream contains multiple 10-FTE teams.
orgDesign.groupLeadershipPrinciple: Every group has explicit lightweight leadership: a Head of group, product and engineering directors, and principal/staff-plus IC coverage for architecture, product quality, and cross-team standards.
